_broker_note: V4.106.0: the LLM Quota Broker is the quota authority — it sees the Taiwan-stock project's spend on the same subscriptions, which config/llm_usage.json never could. The budgets below are now the FALLBACK, enforced only when the broker cannot answer. degradable_roles are the only roles allowed to take that fallback; every other role stops. A broker that answers 'no capacity' stops all roles, news included, because that answer is about the 20% hard reserve. protocol_tokens is the pre-run estimate for one agentic protocol run: deliberately generous, and worth re-tuning from `lqb history` once real runs have been recorded.
_budgets_note: daily_max_calls resets at UTC midnight. window_max_calls/window_hours is an independent rolling window that does NOT reset at midnight — it mirrors the provider's session window. Omit window_max_calls (or set 0) to leave a model uncapped on that axis; gemini/grok are rate-limited per-minute rather than per-session, so only the session-window CLIs carry one.
